transcript.content: Hi, I changed my password yesterday like the email told me to, and now I can't log in to anything. This is really bad timing.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can I start with your name and company?
James Wilson, Mercer & Tate Law.
Thanks James. When did this start exactly?
Right after I changed the password yesterday afternoon.
Is it just you affected, or are others in your firm having issues too?
Just me, as far as I know.
What's the impact of not being able to log in right now?
I can't access my email or the document management system. I have a court filing deadline at 3pm today.
I understand that's urgent. What happens when you try to log in?
It says invalid credentials on everything — Outlook, Teams, the document system.
Do you see any MFA prompts when you try?
Yes, the MFA prompt comes up on my phone, but then it still says password is wrong.
That's helpful. Let me check your account on our end. One moment please.
Okay.
James, I can see your account is locked due to the password change not syncing properly. Let me reset the sync and unlock it. I'll send a new temp password to your manager's email on file.
Okay, how long will that take?
About 5 minutes for the sync to complete. Your manager will have the temp password. Once you log in, you'll be prompted to set a new one. I recommend something different from your old password.
Perfect, thank you.
I'll monitor the sync and confirm once it's done. I'm also logging this ticket with the details so we have a record. If you have any issues after the reset, call us back immediately.

ticket.summary: User James Wilson at Mercer & Tate Law cannot log into M365 after password change. Account locked due to sync issue.
ticket.description: User: James Wilson, Mercer & Tate Law. Device: Windows desktop + iPhone. Issue: Password changed yesterday, now cannot log into Outlook, Teams, or document management. Scope: Single user. Impact: Cannot access email or documents for court filing. Urgency: Deadline at 3pm today. Error: Invalid credentials on all apps. MFA prompts appear but password rejected. Diagnosis: Account locked after password change sync failure. Action: Reset sync, unlock account, temp password sent to manager. Next step: Log in with temp password, set new password, verify all apps.

expected.notes: Ideal password reset call. Everything covered including MFA awareness, urgency, and proper escalation path.
